description: Get the stocks members of Congress traded most over a trailing window, aggregated across EVERY member and ticker — 'what did Congress buy this week' without needing a ticker or a member name. The window is anchored on the DISCLOSURE (filing) date because the STOCK Act's general outside filing deadline is 45 days after a trade; late or amended records can arrive later. Each row aggregates one stock's disclosed trades: distinct members buying and selling, trade counts, estimated dollar flow per direction (each disclosed amount range's midpoint — members disclose a band, not an exact figure), the largest participants, and the latest filing and transaction dates. direction=buys ranks by estimated net buying, direction=sells by estimated net selling; chamber=senate/house narrows to one chamber. Use GetCongressionalTrades for one stock's underlying disclosures and GetMemberTrades for one member's.

chamber.description: Filter by chamber: 'senate' or 'house' (defaults to both).

days.description: Trailing disclosure window in days (default: 30, max: 365).

direction.description: Ranking direction: 'buys' (most net congressional buying first, default) or 'sells' (most net selling first).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 25, max: 200).

name: GetMarketWideCongressionalActivity
